results.notes: Analysis used: UA = Electric bikes (42c3ab89, topic Electric bikes instead of Postal services, GB only, ChatGPT + Gemini, latest collection 21 Oct 2026). Export analysis > Presentation .pptx -> POST /geo/api/v1/reports/42c3ab89-.../export/pptx?marketCodes=master&llms=openai,gemini&lang=en-GB (200) -> Electric_bikes_AI_Visibility_Report.pptx (96 744 bytes, 10 slides). No PPTX renderer available: content read from ppt/slides/*.xml; step3/4/5 screenshots show a rendered extract. Cover: 'Onclusive | GEO ANALYTICS | E | Electric bikes | AI Visibility Report | Oct 21, 2026', 3 InBrief bullets, Markets United Kingdom, AI engines ChatGPT · Gemini, Categories Commuter Electric Bikes. Slides: 2 IDENTITY · OVERVIEW 'The topics the answers raise'; 3 PERFORMANCE · OVERVIEW 'How the answers split across brands' (SOV); 4 PERFORMANCE · OVERVIEW 'How the brands rank in the answers' (landscape top 10); 5 SOURCES · OVERVIEW; 6-9 COMMUTER ELECTRIC BIKES · CATEGORY (SOV, 'Brand prioritization in Commuter Electric Bikes', topics, sources); 10 OTHER · CATEGORY topics. Footer 'Electric bikes AI Visibility Report — N'. Section labels use the category names. No KPI cards, Time Evolution, Category Prioritization, Corporate Reputation, Brand Territory or Action Center slide (brand reference Toyota deck of 21/10: 24 slides with KPI, 5 evolution slides, category matrix, competitor positioning and an Actions · Target Sources slide). 'your brand': 0 match in 10 slides + layouts + masters (non-breaking spaces normalised). 'target': 0 match in text nodes. Ranking slide 4 uses only neutral colours (0F172A text, E2E8F0 separators, no accent fill, no bold row); SOV slides use the per-brand palette with the same style for every slice; matrix colours = quadrant colours only. First-run side observations, all still present (outside this TC's assertions): date 'Oct 21, 2026' is US format with lang=en-GB (UI shows '21 Oct 2026'); 'Mixed · 1 topics' (slides 8 and 10) plural; the category landscape table of the dashboard is not exported (fewer widgets, not more); matrix slide shows 'At Risk · 4 brands' + MiRider in a separate cluster vs legend 'At Risk 5' (and the brand-matrix API returns MONITOR for these brands, see r2 GEO-1244). Topic export copy (strings sheet 'Proposed' tab) still not available locally: the local Translation workbook has only the 'All strings' sheet, no export strings - wording not compared.

results.title: The XLSX export of an unbranded analysis uses the topic and skips dropped sheets
results.error: Expected: "No match; no target column or marker". Observed: 0 "your brand" and 0 "target" match, no highlighted row, but the Raw Data sheet still has the "Favorability" column with N/A on every row (10 rows). Favorability is a target-brand metric and the unbranded AI Citation Sources widget has no Favorability column (GEO-1243 AC-10), while the export must contain the same widgets as the unbranded dashboard, nothing more. PO decision needed: drop the column for a topic or keep it as N/A.
